reviewSamples.author: Photo of Aqua
reviewSamples.text: Craving sweets? Yummy is indeed the place to go! Cakes, Cupcakes, Banana pudding OMG! So good! The atmosphere is so pretty, the fragrance; smells so good!! My go to, when I have a sweet tooth!  10 out of 10, I highly recommend Lol.

reviewSamples.author: Photo of Evelyn Whittaker
reviewSamples.text: The location is pretty convenient and easily accessible. I had the banana pudding cheesecake brownie. Which was really soft, fresh and a large portion. It does lean a little bit sweet, but that’s my preference.
